descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Ramona' Rare Japanese Maple Zones 5 - 9 'Ramona' is a brand new selection of Japanese maple that will quickly become one your favorites! In the spring, bright orange red new growth gives a 'Ueno yama' like appearance. This fades to green by mid-spring. When 'Ramona' really begins to shine is late spring to early summer. The green older growth becomes more and more yellow-green to yellow. New growth flushes of coral pink begin to emerge over this yellow creating a dynamic contrast. ‘Ramona’ is expected to get 6-8 ft in height and width in 10 years with an upright habit. This is a new Japanese maple that is really grabbing our attention here at MrMaple. I know you will enjoy this beauty.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Ramona'，珍稀日本枫，适生区 5-9。‘Ramona’ 是一个全新的日本枫选育品种，很快就会成为你的心头好之一。春季新梢呈鲜亮的橙红色，外观有些类似 ‘Ueno yama’，到春季中期会逐渐转绿。‘Ramona’ 真正开始出彩是在晚春到初夏阶段，较老的绿色叶片会越来越偏黄绿色，直至黄色；与此同时，珊瑚粉色的新梢不断抽发，与黄叶形成鲜明而富有变化的对比。‘Ramona’ 预计 10 年可长至高、宽各 6-8 英尺，株形直立。这个新品种在 MrMaple 这里非常引人注目，相信你也会喜欢这株美树。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。建议您看到心仪品种及时购买，因为部分精选品种常常很快售罄。
